operating_point.platform: CPU (GitHub runner for rates; this laptop for the gates' single runs)
operating_point.sizes_and_parameters: water (mu 1e-3, rho 1e3); tube radius 0.5 mm, D/h 16 unless stated; sphere radius 40 um to 2h; IMEX Euler or its steady limit, Stokes; dt 0.1 to 0.5 ms (r = nu dt/h^2 0.03 to 0.15 at D/h 16)
operating_point.seeds_and_draws: the adjoint oracle over 60 seeded draws (box 12 to 23 cells, h in {1, 0.25, 1/32}, 1 to 5 points, widths 1 to 2 cells)

gate_1_adjoint.claim: the exchange law's gather and scatter are a transpose pair in the grid's inner product, <S f, u> = f . G u, for the kernel's average and its Laplacian, through the registered mapping kind

prediction.unit: relative to the products' magnitudes, float64 (float32: 1e-6)
prediction.basis: derived: one set of weights both ways
prediction.why: the same stencil, the same products, summed in a different order

control.plant: the gather's width 1e-9 wider; half a cell off; the Laplacian on one side only

gate_2_still_fluid.claim: one point body in a free box (no wall), coupled two-way, moves at its uncoupled Stokes speed M0 F less Hasimoto's image term, at steady state

prediction.basis: derived plus measured-before (the box's images beyond Hasimoto's about 6e-4 at 32 cells)

gate_3_uniform_drive.claim: a neutrally buoyant point body on a driven tube's axis, two-way, accelerates with the fluid it reads (before the wall's viscous front reaches the axis)

control.expected_rate: every run, slip (2/9) a^2 g/nu over V: 4 % at the smoke run's point

gate_4_faxen.claim: a force-free point body in steady Poiseuille flow moves at u(b) + (a^2/6) lap u, Faxén's closed form, on the grid's own profile

prediction.unit: |V - V_Faxen| / U at a = sigma = h, D/h 16
prediction.why: the profile's fit residual away from the band; the Faxén term itself 1.0 % of U and the bare kernel's 3.1 %

control.plant: the Faxén pair off (the bare kernel's sigma^2/2)

gate_5_added_mass.claim: one-way, a body twice the fluid's density in a uniformly accelerating fluid slips with the backward-Euler closed form of (m + m_f/2) dw/dt = (m_f - m) g - R0 w

prediction.basis: derived: the node's step is that recurrence when the fluid's acceleration is uniform

gate_6_rate_terms_stable.claim: the rate terms read on the flow without the body stay finite at the floor sweep's NaN arm (lagged, a = 1.33 sigma, r = 0.03, a near-massless body), and read on the constant correction they diverge

prediction.value: finite, within 1 of the terminal speed

control.plant: the rate terms on the constant correction's reading
control.expected_rate: every run: NaN or over 1e3 times the terminal speed within 200 steps

gate_7_floor.claim: the build refuses a point body whose margin no width on the ladder lifts above 0.2 (drag.stokes-floor), and plans one whose does

prediction.value: refused at a = 8h (widest 4 cells: a/sigma 2), planned at a = h

gate_8_ledger.claim: the flow's step identity with the exchange closes to its rounding floor (IDENTITY_ULPS) at every step, the exchange's work booked under the drag; the lagged scheme's unpaired share is first order in dt

prediction.value: closes; unpaired share halves with dt (order 1.0 +- 0.3)

gate_9_gradient.claim: a derivative through the exchange law (the body's displacement in the fluid's viscosity, float64) matches a central difference, and a stop_gradient on the exchange makes it fail

prediction.basis: R4 (2.7e-9 at an FVM's size), guessed looser for the fitted modes
